title: Jagged Croatian Garlicky Aerated Monsoon Pilaf
description: A hearty, flavorful pilaf inspired by the cuisine of Croatia, perfect for a monsoon evening. This recipe is low in carbs and rich in flavor.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large, heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is coated in oil and slightly toasted.
Pour in the chicken broth, rendered pork fat, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover the pan with a lid.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender.
Remove the pan from heat and stir in the chopped fresh basil and grated Parmesan cheese.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
If the pilaf seems too dense, you can try adding a little extra chicken broth and stirring to fluff it up.
